name: barbell leg twist press
description: A combined move where a leg rotation pairs with an overhead press with a barbell. Trains legs, trunk and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a barbell at your shoulders with feet shoulder width apart.
Step one foot out and rotate your hips and torso with it, bending into a rotated lunge.
Drive back up and press the bar overhead as you stand.
Lower the bar to your shoulders.
